meta.name: elevenlabs-voice-isolator
meta.description: ElevenLabs voice isolator - remove background noise and isolate vocals from audio via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: noise removal, voice extraction, audio cleanup, background removal. Use for: podcast cleanup, interview audio, music vocals, noisy recordings, audio restoration. Triggers: voice isolator, noise removal, background removal, isolate voice, clean audio, remove background noise, audio cleanup, voice extraction, elevenlabs isolator, eleven labs noise, vocal isolation, denoise, audio restoration, voice separation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从音频中分离人声并去除背景噪音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从录音中提取清晰人声或去除嘈杂背景音
copy.tagline_en: Isolate vocals and remove background noise from audio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract clear vocals or remove background noise from recordings

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行去除音频中的背景噪音，提取纯净人声。支持 WAV、MP3、FLAC、OGG、AAC 格式，文件最大 500MB，时长最长 1 小时。
howto.when: 当你提到“噪音去除”、“人声提取”、“音频清理”等关键词，或要求处理嘈杂录音时触发。

say.text: 帮我清理这段播客录音的背景噪音。
say.note: Claude 会运行隔离器处理音频。
Claude 会分离人声和伴奏。

say.text: 去除这个采访音频里的咖啡店噪音。
say.note: Claude 会隔离说话人声音。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can remove background noise and isolate vocals from audio via command line. Supports WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, AAC formats, up to 500MB and 1 hour duration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'noise removal', 'voice extraction', 'audio cleanup', or ask to process noisy recordings.

say_en.text: Clean up the background noise in this podcast recording.
say_en.note: Claude will run the isolator on the audio.

say_en.text: Extract the vocals from this song.
say_en.note: Claude will separate vocals from instrumental.

say_en.text: Remove the café noise from this interview audio.
say_en.note: Claude will isolate the speaker's voice.
